KQC Quantum, Inc. and Charlton Aria Acquisition Corporation Announce Shareholder Approval of Business Combination Deadline Extension

Charlton Aria shareholder approvals effectively extend business combination deadline through up to October 25, 2027

WILMINGTON, Del. & BUSAN, South Korea--(BUSINESS WIRE)--KQC Quantum, Inc. (“KQC Parent”), the Delaware parent company of Korea Quantum Computing Co., Ltd. (“KQC” or the “Company”), which helps enterprises adopt quantum computing and quantum-safe security, and Charlton Aria Acquisition Corporation (Nasdaq: CHAR) (“Charlton Aria”), a publicly traded special purpose acquisition company, today announced results from a special meeting held on October 19, 2026 at which Charlton Aria shareholders approved proposals to extend the deadline by which Charlton Aria must complete an initial business combination.

The approved amendments allow Charlton Aria to extend its business combination deadline from October 25, 2026 to October 25, 2027, through up to twelve successive one-month extensions.

The extension provides Charlton Aria with additional time to complete its previously announced proposed business combination with KQC. The proposed transaction remains subject to customary closing conditions, including applicable regulatory and shareholder approvals.

Additional information regarding the shareholder vote and approved amendments is available in Charlton Aria's Current Report on Form 8-K filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (“SEC”).

About KQC Quantum, Inc.

KQC Quantum, Inc. is the Delaware parent company of Korea Quantum Computing Co., Ltd., which was founded in 2021 and is headquartered in Busan, South Korea, with an office in Seoul. For more information, visit www.kqcquantum.com.

About Charlton Aria Acquisition Corporation

Charlton Aria Acquisition Corporation (Nasdaq: CHAR) is a blank check company incorporated in the Cayman Islands as an exempted company with limited liability for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities.
